meta.name: model-router
meta.description: Intelligent model selection engine for NEURO API. Automatically identifies which of 120+ models are optimal for a given task, then routes execution to the right models. Integrates with every skill chain to ensure multi-model intelligence on every non-trivial operation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按任务自动挑选最优 AI 模型并执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在开发 AI 功能,常为模型选择纠结
copy.tagline_en: Automatically pick and run the best AI model for each task
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI features and want auto model selection for cost and quality

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析任务，从 120 多个专业模型中选出匹配的模型来执行，并给出推荐列表供 NEURO API 使用，而不是只用同一个通用模型。
howto.when: 当你说出 “model”、“route”、“select” 等关键词，或要求为任务挑选模型时触发。

say.text: 这个安全审计任务该用哪些模型？
帮我路由这个代码审查到合适的模型
用模型路由器挑选财务风险分析模型
say.note: 推荐财务与数据类模型

howto.what_en: After install, Claude analyzes each task and picks suitable models from 120+ specialized ones, then routes execution to them. It returns a recommended list for the NEURO API.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “model”, “route”, “select”, or ask to pick a model for a task.

say_en.text: Which models should I use for this security audit?
Route this code review to the right models.
Use the model router to pick models for financial risk analysis.
